originalTitle: GODZILLA MINUS ZERO | Official 1.43:1 Trailer | Filmed For IMAX
content: Everything ends here. Experience GODZILLA MINUS ZERO, the first-ever Japanese production #FilmedForIMAX, in theatres November 6. GODZILLA MINUS ZERO VFX, Written, and Directed by Takashi Yamazaki In theatres November 6 Follow @godzilla_toho and @GKIDSfilms for more updates! godzillaminuszero.com War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant. There is no third time. Everything ends here. Shot entirely in Japan as the first-ever Japanese production to be Filmed For IMAX, GODZILLA MINUS ZERO was shot with high-definition digital cameras certified by IMAX, and optimized in sound and imagery unique to IMAX screens. The globally beloved monster returns to movie theater screens reaching greater and more terrifying heights, making GODZILLA MINUS ZERO a true cinematic event not to be missed.

chineseContent: 一切到这里就结束了。体验首部日本制作#FilmedForIMAX 的《哥斯拉减零》将于 11 月 6 日在影院上映。 《哥斯拉减零》视觉特效由山崎隆编剧和导演，将于 11 月 6 日在影院上映 关注 @godzilla_toho 和 @GKIDSfilms 以获取更多更新！ godzillaminuszero.com 战争将日本降至零，而哥斯拉则将其降至负值。两年过去了，这个国家经历了艰苦的斗争，才得以恢复并最终恢复正常生活。正当人类努力维持来之不易的和平时，新的威胁袭来，希望瞬间破灭。没有第三次了。一切到这里就结束了。 《哥斯拉减零》完全在日本拍摄，是首部在 IMAX 上拍摄的日本作品，采用经过 IMAX 认证的高清数码摄像机拍摄，并针对 IMAX 屏幕特有的声音和图像进行了优化。全球深受喜爱的怪兽重返电影院银幕，达到了更高、更恐怖的高度，使《零之哥斯拉》成为一场不容错过的真正电影盛事。
